_note: Fixed items of the HART Railroad Layout Editor panel that the schematic does not draw; tools/schematic/panel_items.py reads and places them. Kept by hand. First written 2026-11-17 from the approved staging candidate's placements (build_layout_le.py --levels staging --as-live), so the device-map path puts them where that candidate has them. The status cluster keeps the names panel_status.py looks for.
